title: financial-apiAbortedOrderDto
description: Represents an unpaid, non-committed order that has been fully aborted.

staffName.description: The name of the staff member who aborted the order.

timeOfAbortedOrder.description: The timestamp when the order was aborted and all line items fully cleared.

totalAmountAborted.description: The total value of the aborted order.

abortedLineItems.description: A list of all line items that were removed from the aborted order.

itemName.description: The name of the item that was removed from the order.

itemSku.description: The SKU of the item that was removed from the order.

itemQuantity.description: The quantity of the item removed from the order.

itemAmount.description: The total price for this item (itemPrice * itemQuantity).

itemPrice.description: The unit price of the item removed from the order.
